31010.title: The Unexpected Compression: Competition at Work in the Low Wage Labor Market
31010.zh_title: 意外的压缩：低工资劳动力市场中的竞争效应
31010.authors: David Autor, Arindrajit Dube, Annie McGrew
31010.zh_abstract_excerpt: 新冠疫情高峰后的劳动力市场紧张导致美国工资分布出现意外的压缩，这在一定程度上反映了劳动力市场竞争的加剧。工资分布底部的快速相对工资增长降低了大学工资溢价，并抵消了四十年来总体90/10对数工资不平等增长的大约三分之一。工资压缩伴随着名义工资的快速增长和岗位间离职率的上升——尤其是在年轻的非大学（高中或以下学历）工人中。跨州比较显示，疫情后的劳动力市场紧张程度对低工资工人的实际工资增长（工资-菲利普斯曲线）和总体工资压缩具有很强的预测能力。
31010.abstract: Labor market tightness following the height of the Covid-19 pandemic led to an unexpected compression in the US wage distribution that reflects, in part, an increase in labor market competition. Rapid relative wage growth at the bottom of the distribution reduced the college wage premium and counteracted around one-third of the four-decade increase in aggregate 90/10 log wage inequality. Wage compression was accompanied by rapid nominal wage growth and rising job-to-job separations—especially among young non-college (high school or less) workers. Comparing across states, post-pandemic labor market tightness became strongly predictive of real wage growth among low-wage workers (wage-Phillips curve), and aggregate wage compression. Simultaneously, the wage-separation elasticity—a key measure of labor market competition—rose among young non-college workers, with wage gains concentrated among workers who changed employers. Seen through the lens of a canonical job ladder model, the pandemic reduced employer market power by increasing the elasticity of labor supply to firms in the low-wage labor market. This spurred rapid relative wage growth among young non-college workers, who disproportionately moved from lower-paying to higher-paying and potentially more productive jobs.

31009.title: Robots and Workers: Evidence from the Netherlands
31009.zh_title: 机器人与工人：来自荷兰的证据
31009.authors: Daron Acemoglu, Hans R. A. Koster, Ceren Ozgen
31009.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用涵盖2009-2020年的大型雇主-雇员面板数据集，估算了荷兰机器人采用对企业层面和工人层面结果的影响。我们的企业层面结果证实了先前的发现，即机器人采用对采用企业增加值和工作时间有积极影响，而对同行业的竞争对手则产生负面结果。我们的工人层面结果显示，直接受影响的工人（例如，从事常规或可替代任务的蓝领工人）面临更低的收入和就业率，而其他工人则间接从机器人采用中获益。
31009.abstract: We estimate the effects of robot adoption on firm-level and worker-level outcomes in the Netherlands using a large employer-employee panel dataset spanning 2009-2020. Our firm-level results confirm previous findings, with positive effects on value added and hours worked for robot-adopting firms and negative outcomes on competitors in the same industry. Our worker-level results show that directly-affected workers (e.g., blue-collar workers performing routine or replaceable tasks) face lower earnings and employment rates, while other workers indirectly gain from robot adoption. We also find that the negative effects from competitors' robot adoption load on directly-affected workers, while other workers benefit from this industry-level robot adoption. Overall, our results highlight the uneven effects of automation on the workforce.

31008.title: Input Subsidies and the Destruction of Natural Capital: Chinese Distant Water Fishing
31008.zh_title: 投入补贴与自然资本的破坏：中国远洋渔业
31008.authors: Gabriel Englander, Jihua Zhang, Juan Carlos Villaseñor-Derbez, Qutu Jiang, Mingzhao Hu, Olivier Deschenes, Christopher Costello
31008.zh_abstract_excerpt: 自然资源部门的投入补贴被广泛认为会导致该部门所依赖的自然资本的枯竭。然而，识别和数据方面的挑战阻碍了实证估计补贴对资源开采因果效应的尝试。中国的捕鱼船队是世界上规模最大的，2016年，政府将其对远洋渔船的燃油补贴政策改为根据预定船舶特征递增的补贴方式。该政策设定了25个阈值，补贴在这些阈值处不连续地增加。利用断点回归设计，我们估计燃油补贴每增加1%，捕鱼时长增加2.2%。将中国远洋燃油补贴减少50%，可以消除多个海洋区域的生物性过度捕捞。
31008.abstract: Input subsidies in natural resource sectors are widely believed to cause depletion of the natural capital on which those sectors rely. But identification and data challenges have stymied attempts to empirically estimate the causal effect of subsidies on resource extraction. China’s fishing fleet is the world’s largest, and in 2016 the government changed its fuel subsidy policy for distant water vessels to one that increases with predetermined vessel characteristics. The policy features 25 thresholds at which subsidies discontinuously increase. Using a regression discontinuity design, we estimate that a 1% increase in fuel subsidy increases hours of fishing by 2.2%. Reducing Chinese distant water fuel subsidies by 50% could eliminate biological overfishing in several ocean regions.

31007.title: Remote Work across Jobs, Companies, and Space
31007.zh_title: 跨工作、公司和空间的远程工作
31007.authors: Stephen Hansen, Peter John Lambert, Nicholas Bloom, Steven J. Davis, Raffaella Sadun, Bledi Taska
31007.zh_abstract_excerpt: 疫情催化了向远程工作的持久转变。为了衡量这种转变，我们考察了五个英语国家超过5亿个职位空缺公告。我们的测量依赖于一个大型语言模型，我们使用3万个人工分类对其进行了微调。该模型达到了99%的分类准确率，显著优于基于词典的方法，并且尽管规模较小，但其性能与前沿AI模型相当。从2019年到2025年，表明新员工每周至少可以远程工作一天的职位公告份额，在美国增长了三倍多，在澳大利亚、加拿大、新西兰和英国增长了五倍或更多。
31007.abstract: The pandemic catalyzed an enduring shift to remote work. To measure this shift, we examine more than 500 million job vacancy postings across five English-speaking countries. Our measurements rely on a large language model (LLM) that we fine-tune with 30,000 human classifications. The model achieves 99% classification accuracy, substantially outperforming dictionary-based approaches and—despite being a fraction of the size—performs on par with frontier AI models. From 2019 to 2025, the share of postings indicating that new employees can work remotely at least one day per week rose more than three-fold in the U.S. and by a factor of five or more in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and the U.K. These developments are highly non-uniform across and within cities, industries, occupations, and companies. Even when zooming in on employers in the same industry competing for talent in the same occupations, we find large differences in the share of job postings that explicitly offer remote work.

31006.title: Revisiting Productivity Dynamics in Europe: A New Measure of Utilization-Adjusted TFP Growth
31006.zh_title: 重新审视欧洲的生产率动态：一种新的利用率调整后全要素生产率增长度量
31006.authors: Diego A. Comin, Javier Quintana, Tom G. Schmitz, Antonella Trigari
31006.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们计算了欧洲五大经济体的全要素生产率增长的新估计值。我们的估计考虑了正利润，并使用企业调查来代理要素利用率的未观测变化。这些创新产生了重大影响：我们估计的全要素生产率增长序列比使用标准方法得到的序列波动性更小、周期性更弱。基于我们的方法，我们提供了年度行业层面和总体的全要素生产率序列，以及欧洲首个经利润和利用率调整后的季度全要素生产率增长估计值。
31006.abstract: We compute new estimates of Total Factor Productivity (TFP) growth in the five largest European economies. Our estimates account for positive profits and use firm surveys to proxy for unobserved changes in factor utilization. These novelties have a major impact: our estimated TFP growth series are substantially less volatile and less cyclical than the ones obtained with standard methods. Based on our approach, we provide annual industry-level and aggregate TFP series, as well as the first estimates of profit and utilization-adjusted quarterly TFP growth in Europe.

31005.title: Partial Identification of Treatment-Effect Distributions with Count-Valued Outcomes
31005.zh_title: 计数结果下处理效应分布的部分识别
31005.zh_abstract_excerpt: 对于计数结果y∈{0,1,...,M}，平均处理效应的识别和估计除了连续结果情形下的考虑外，没有特殊之处。然而，如果关注的是处理效应分布的部分识别，计数结果则带来了一些微妙但重要的考虑，超出了连续结果背景下的问题。本文推导了计数结果下处理效应分布的适当边界。
31005.abstract: With count-valued outcomes y in {0,1,...,M} identification and estimation of average treatment effects raise no special considerations beyond those involved in the continuous-outcome case. If partial identification of the distribution of treatment effects is of interest, however, count-valued outcomes present some subtle yet important considerations beyond those involved in continuous-outcome contexts. This paper derives appropriate bounds on the distribution of treatment effects for count-valued outcomes.

31004.title: The Global Dollar Cycle
31004.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美元的名义有效汇率密切追踪全球金融状况，而全球金融状况本身呈现出周期性模式。在该周期中，世界资产价格、杠杆和资本流动与全球增长同步变动，尤其影响新兴和发展中经济体的命运。本文记录了美元升值冲击预示着新兴和发展中经济体的经济衰退，并强调了各国可以实施以减弱美元波动影响的政策。美元升值冲击本身不仅与美国紧缩的货币政策高度相关，还与衡量美国国内和国际美元融资压力的指标高度相关，而这些指标本身反映了全球投资者的风险偏好。
31004.abstract: The U.S. dollar’s nominal effective exchange rate closely tracks global financial conditions, which themselves show a cyclical pattern. Over that cycle, world asset prices, leverage, and capital flows move in concert with global growth, especially influencing the fortunes of emerging and developing economies (EMDEs). This paper documents that dollar appreciation shocks predict economic downturns in EMDEs and highlights policies countries could implement to dampen the effects of dollar fluctuations. Dollar appreciation shocks themselves are highly correlated not just with tighter U.S. monetary policies, but also with measures of U.S. domestic and international dollar funding stress that themselves reflect global investors’ risk appetite. After the initial market panic and upward dollar spike at the start of the COVID-19 pandemic, the dollar fell as global financial conditions eased; but the higher inflation that followed has induced central banks everywhere to tighten monetary policies more recently. The dollar has strengthened considerably since mid-2021 and a contractionary phase of the global financial cycle is now under way. Owing to increases in public- and business-sector debts during the pandemic, a strong dollar, higher interest rates, and slower economic growth will be challenging for EMDEs.

31003.title: Asymmetries in Federal Reserve Objectives
31003.zh_title: 美联储目标的不对称性
31003.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文利用联邦公开市场委员会经济预测摘要的证据表明，美国货币政策制定者对失业和通胀结果的目标并不能通过传统的二次损失函数很好地近似。相反，政策制定者从超出（低于）其长期通胀和失业目标中获得了实质性成本（收益）。由此产生的失业和通胀向下倾斜之间的权衡，在塑造自大衰退以来货币政策选择的演变中发挥了关键作用。
31003.abstract: This paper uses evidence from the Federal Open Market Committee’s Summary of Economic Projections to show that US monetary policymakers have objectives over unemployment and inflation outcomes that are not well-approximated through a conventional quadratic loss function. Rather, policymakers derive material costs (benefits) from overshooting (undershooting) their long-run inflation and unemployment goals. The trade-off between the resultant downward tilts in unemployment and inflation played a key role in shaping the evolution of monetary policy choices since the Great Recession.

31002.title: Competitive Model Selection in Algorithmic Targeting
31002.zh_title: 算法定向中的竞争性模型选择
31002.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究了在定向背景下，市场竞争如何影响企业的算法设计选择。企业在选择监督学习算法的设计时，面临偏差与方差之间的普遍权衡，这体现在模型复杂度或要容纳的预测变量数量上。然后，每家企业任命一名数据分析师，该分析师使用所选算法来估计多个消费者群体的需求，并据此制定定向策略以最大化估计利润。我们表明，竞争可能诱使企业战略性地选择更简单、包含更多偏差的算法。这意味着更复杂/灵活的算法往往对拥有更大垄断势力的企业具有更高价值。
31002.abstract: This paper studies how market competition influences the algorithmic design choices of firms in the context of targeting. Firms face the general trade-off between bias and variance when choosing the design of a supervised learning algorithm in terms of model complexity or the number of predictors to accommodate. Each firm then appoints a data analyst that uses the chosen algorithm to estimate demand for multiple consumer segments, based on which, it devises a targeting policy to maximize estimated profit. We show that competition may induce firms to strategically choose simpler algorithms which involve more bias. This implies that more complex/flexible algorithms tend to have higher value for firms with greater monopoly power.

31001.title: Multidimensional Human Capital and the Wage Structure
31001.zh_title: 多维人力资本与工资结构
31001.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文回顾并综合了关于人力资本理论宏观经济含义的文献。我首先回顾了由Tinbergen（1975）开创、并由Goldin和Katz（2007）更充分发展的教育与工资结构的经典模型。我还回顾了诸如由Acemoglu和Autor（2011）发展的任务框架等创新。经典模型在预测过去半个世纪美国及其他发达国家工资结构变化方面表现得出奇地好。相对于经典模型，任务框架采用了更灵活的技术观点，并且在拟合工资结构的非单调变化方面做得更好。
31001.abstract: This paper reviews and synthesizes the literature on the macroeconomic implications of human capital theory. I begin with a review of the canonical model of education and the wage structure pioneered by Tinbergen (1975) and developed more fully by Goldin and Katz (2007). I also review innovations such as the task framework developed by Acemoglu and Autor (2011). The canonical model does a surprisingly good job of predicting changes in the wage structure in the U.S. and other developed countries over the last half-century. Relative to the canonical model, the task framework adopts a more flexible view of technology and does a better job of fitting non-monotonic changes in the wage structure. Yet the task framework does not fully explain why educated workers have done so well since 1980, nor does it explain other recent facts such as flattening returns to cognitive skills and growing returns to non-cognitive, “higher-order” skills such as teamwork. To understand these recent trends, we must move beyond a single index view of human capital, toward richer, multi-dimensional frameworks. I conclude with a discussion of the nascent literature on the implications of multi-dimensional human capital for the wage structure, which raises more questions than it answers.

31000.title: Human Capital and Climate Change
31000.authors: Noam Angrist, Kevin Winseck, Harry A. Patrinos, Joshua S. Graff Zivin
31000.zh_abstract_excerpt: 应对气候变化需要个人行为改变以及选民对亲气候政策的支持，然而，关于如何实现这些结果，我们知之甚少。本文利用20个欧洲国家新的义务教育法数据，估计了额外教育对亲气候结果的因果效应。我们分析了教育对亲气候信念和行为的影响，以及对政策偏好和投票支持绿党等新颖数据的影响。结果表明，一年的教育显著增加了亲气候信念、行为和政策偏好。

In this paper, we estimate causal effects of additional education on pro-climate outcomes using new compulsory schooling law data across 20 European countries. We analyze effects on pro-climate beliefs and behaviors, as well as novel data on policy preferences and voting for green parties. Results show that a year of education substantially increases pro-climate beliefs, behaviors, and policy preferences.

31029.title: Macroeconomic Effects of ‘Free’ Secondary Schooling in the Developing World
31029.zh_title: 发展中国家“免费”中学教育的宏观经济效应
31029.authors: Junichi Fujimoto, David Lagakos, Mitchell VanVuren
31029.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究了发展中国家公共资助（“免费”）中学教育的宏观经济效应。我们的分析基于一个我们估计的人力资本积累重叠世代模型，该模型与加纳针对贫困但有才华学生的奖学金实验证据相匹配。该模型预测，全国性的免费中学教育会提高平均教育水平，但长期内会降低人均GDP。模型中免费教育带来的人力资本收益被受教育年份的收入损失、新生的负向选择以及高能力家庭生育率的下降所抵消。
31029.abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic effects of publicly funded (‘free’) secondary schooling in the developing world. Our analysis is based on an over-lapping generations model of human capital accumulation that we estimate to match experimental evidence on the effects of scholarships for poor but talented students in Ghana. The model predicts that nationwide free secondary schooling increases average education levels but reduces GDP per capita in the long run. The human capital gains from free schooling in the model are offset by lost income during schooling years, negative selection of new students, and reductions in fertility by high-ability households.

31028.title: The Race Between Education, Technology, and the Minimum Wage
31028.zh_title: 教育、技术与最低工资之间的竞赛
31028.zh_abstract_excerpt: 最低工资对大学教育溢价的影响是什么？我发展了一个理论，该理论暗示这种影响在短期内应该很小——仅提高受最低工资约束的工人的工资——并随时间推移而增长。在我的理论指导下，我提供的证据表明这些动态效应存在且强大。在国家和州层面的估计中，我表明最低工资——连同供给和需求——在塑造美国大学教育溢价的演变中发挥着核心作用，并且大学教育溢价对最低工资的弹性在短期内很小，但随时间推移显著增长。
31028.abstract: What is the impact of the minimum wage on the college wage premium? I develop a theory that implies that the effect should be small on impact—raising only the wages of workers bound by the minimum wage—and grow over time. Guided by my theory, I present evidence that these dynamic effects are present and powerful. Estimated at the national and state levels, I show that minimum wages—together with supply and demand—play a central role in shaping the evolution of the U.S. college premium and that the elasticity of the college premium to the minimum wage is small on impact and grows dramatically over time. To verify my theory’s mechanisms, I additionally document the dynamic impact of the minimum wage over the full wage distribution: on impact, wages rise only for the lowest centiles (consistent with the literature) but over time this effect spills over up the wage distribution (consistent with my theory and my empirical results on the college premium). On the basis of these results, I conclude that the minimum wage plays a central role in shaping the U.S. college premium and its variation across states, in spite of relatively small effects on impact.

31027.title: Identification in a Binary Choice Panel Data Model with a Predetermined Covariate
31027.zh_title: 具有预定协变量的二元选择面板数据模型中的识别
31027.authors: Stéphane Bonhomme, Kevin Dano, Bryan S. Graham
31027.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了一个具有单个预定二元协变量（即，以滞后结果和协变量为条件的序列外生协变量）的二元选择面板数据模型中的识别问题。选择模型由一个标量参数θ索引，而单位特定异质性的分布以及将滞后结果映射到未来协变量实现的反馈过程则不加限制。我们提供了一个简单条件，在该条件下，无论可用的时间周期数有多少，θ都永远无法被点识别。该条件在大多数模型（包括Logit模型）中都得到满足。我们还刻画了θ的识别集，并展示了如何使用线性规划技术计算它。
31027.abstract: We study identification in a binary choice panel data model with a single predetermined binary covariate (i.e., a covariate sequentially exogenous conditional on lagged outcomes and covariates). The choice model is indexed by a scalar parameter θ, whereas the distribution of unit-specific heterogeneity, as well as the feedback process that maps lagged outcomes into future covariate realizations, are left unrestricted. We provide a simple condition under which θ is never point-identified, no matter the number of time periods available. This condition is satisfied in most models, including the logit one. We also characterize the identified set of θ and show how to compute it using linear programming techniques. While θ is not generally point-identified, its identified set is informative in the examples we analyze numerically, suggesting that meaningful learning about θ may be possible even in short panels with feedback. As a complement, we report calculations of identified sets for an average partial effect, and find informative sets in this case as well.

31026.title: The Macroeconomics of Trade Credit
31026.zh_title: 商业信用的宏观经济学
31026.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在大多数国家，中间产品和服务的供应商也是企业短期融资的主要提供者。本文研究了这些金融联系的宏观经济含义。在我们的模型中，商业信用是生产过程中相互关联的企业之间长期合同的结果，并通过声誉力量在均衡中得以维持，因为客户在违约时会失去与供应商的关系。这些金融联系产生了一个信用乘数：供应商可以强制执行这些借据的偿还，并且可以将这些票据向银行贴现以获得流动性。这个过程可以放大或抑制金融冲击对产出的影响，具体取决于供应商的借贷能力。
31026.abstract: In most countries, suppliers of intermediate goods and services are also the main providers of short-term financing to firms. This paper studies the macroeconomic implications of these financial links. In our model, trade credit is the outcome of a long-term contract between firms linked in the production process, and it is sustained in equilibrium by reputation forces as customers lose the relationship with their suppliers in case of a default. These financial links give rise to a credit multiplier: suppliers can enforce repayment of these IOUs, and they can discount these bills with banks to obtain liquidity. This process can either dampen or amplify the output effects of financial shocks, depending on the borrowing capacity of suppliers. Using Italian data, we find that the credit multiplier is sizable and show that trade credit amplified the output costs of the Great Recession by 45%.

31025.title: A Major Shock Makes Prices More Flexible and May Result in a Burst of Inflation or Deflation
31025.zh_title: 重大冲击使价格更具弹性，并可能导致通胀或通缩爆发
31025.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国和其他发达国家在2021年和2022年上半年经历了严重的通胀爆发，随后在2022年下半年，一些国家的通胀有所下降。在价格决定因素（成本和生产率）高度波动的时期，通胀可能快速上升和下降，这与传统菲利普斯曲线所关联的普遍粘性行为相反。本文证实，具有标准新凯恩斯价格粘性的行业容易从粘性快速过渡到弹性，因为销售者选择重新设定价格并放弃锚定。本文表明，伴随疫情的通胀事件中，价格决定因素的跨行业波动性大幅增长。
31025.abstract: The US and other advanced countries suffered bursts of severe inflation in 2021 and the first half of 2022, followed by declines of inflation later in 2022, in some countries. In times of high volatility of price determinants—cost and productivity—inflation can jump upward and fall downward at high speed, contrary to the uniformly sticky behavior associated with traditional Phillips curves. This paper establishes that sectors with standard New Keynesian price stickiness are vulnerable to rapid transitions from stickiness to flexibility, as sellers elect to reset their prices and abandon anchoring. The paper shows that the cross-industry volatility of price determinants grew substantially in the inflation episode accompanying the pandemic. Volatility remained elevated even in late 2022. The logic of the New Keynesian model of the Phillips curve links inflation to volatility, because a larger fraction of sellers are pushed out of their regions of inaction when volatility is elevated. The New Keynesian Phillips curve becomes much steeper in volatile times.

31024.title: International Sanctions and Dollar Dominance

We show how the anticipation of financial sanctions can reduce the US dollar convenience yield and the holdings of US dollar assets. We also evaluate the implications for welfare and show that they are generally detrimental for all countries.

31023.title: Do Older Adults Accurately Forecast Their Social Security Benefits?
31023.zh_title: 老年人能否准确预测其社会保障福利？
31023.zh_abstract_excerpt: 老年人对其未来社会保障福利的预期有多准确？利用健康与退休研究的面板数据，我们将受访者观察到的社会保障领取年龄和福利与他们50多岁和60岁出头时提供的主观预期进行了比较。我们发现，虽然老年人通常对其领取年龄有准确的预期，但他们平均低估了其年度社会保障收入约1,896美元（11.5%）。然而，准确性和精确度都随年龄增长而提高，并且60岁出头人群的预测误差在统计上与零无显著差异。
31023.abstract: How accurate are older people’s expectations about their future Social Security benefits? Using panel data from the Health and Retirement Study, we compare respondents’ observed Social Security claiming ages and benefits with subjective expectations provided during their 50s and early 60s. We find that, while older adults generally have accurate expectations about their claiming age, they underestimate their annual Social Security income by approximately $\$1,896$ (11.5 percent) on average. However, both accuracy and precision increase with age, and the forecast error for people in their early 60s is not statistically different from zero. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in the mailing of Social Security statements, which contain personalized information about future benefits, we show that information provision reduces the forecast error in annual income by $\$344$ (2.1 percent of the average benefit).
31023.zh_abstract: 老年人对其未来社会保障福利的预期有多准确？利用健康与退休研究的面板数据，我们将受访者观察到的社会保障领取年龄和福利与他们50多岁和60岁出头时提供的主观预期进行了比较。我们发现，虽然老年人通常对其领取年龄有准确的预期，但他们平均低估了其年度社会保障收入约1,896美元（11.5%）。然而，准确性和精确度都随年龄增长而提高，并且60岁出头人群的预测误差在统计上与零无显著差异。利用邮寄包含个性化未来福利信息的社会保障对账单这一看似外生的变化，我们表明信息提供使年度收入的预测误差减少了344美元（占平均福利的2.1%）。

31022.title: Biodiversity Finance
31022.authors: Caroline Flammer, Thomas Giroux, Geoffrey Heal
31022.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究生物多样性融资——即利用私人资本为生物多样性保护和恢复提供资金——这是可持续金融中的一种新实践。首先，我们提供了一个概念框架，阐述了生物多样性如何通过纯私人资本和混合融资结构进行融资。在后者中，私人资本与公共或慈善资本混合，其目的是降低私人资本投资的风险。这两种融资类型背后的主要元素是生物多样性的“货币化”，即利用对生物多样性的投资为私人投资者产生财务回报。
31022.abstract: We study biodiversity finance—the use of private capital to finance biodiversity conservation and restoration—which is a new practice in sustainable finance. First, we provide a conceptual framework that lays out how biodiversity can be financed by pure private capital and blended financing structures. In the latter, private capital is blended with public or philanthropic capital, whose aim is to de-risk private capital investments. The main element underlying both types of financing is the “monetization” of biodiversity, that is, using investments in biodiversity to generate a financial return for private investors. Second, we provide empirical evidence using deal-level data from a leading biodiversity finance institution. Our findings are consistent with a three-dimensional efficient frontier (return, risk, and biodiversity impact)—deals with a favorable risk-return profile tend to be financed by pure private capital, whereas for other deals the biodiversity impact needs to be sufficiently large for blended finance to be used. Overall, our results suggest that blended finance is an important tool for improving the risk-return profile of these projects, thereby increasing their appeal to private investors and crowding in private capital. Finally, our results suggest that private capital is unlikely to substitute for effective public policies in addressing the biodiversity crisis.
31022.zh_abstract: 我们研究生物多样性融资——即利用私人资本为生物多样性保护和恢复提供资金——这是可持续金融中的一种新实践。首先，我们提供了一个概念框架，阐述了生物多样性如何通过纯私人资本和混合融资结构进行融资。在后者中，私人资本与公共或慈善资本混合，其目的是降低私人资本投资的风险。这两种融资类型背后的主要元素是生物多样性的“货币化”，即利用对生物多样性的投资为私人投资者产生财务回报。其次，我们使用来自一家领先的生物多样性融资机构的交易层面数据提供了实证证据。我们的发现与三维有效前沿（回报、风险和生物多样性影响）一致——具有有利风险回报特征的交易往往由纯私人资本融资，而对于其他交易，生物多样性影响需要足够大才能使用混合融资。总体而言，我们的结果表明，混合融资是改善这些项目风险回报状况的重要工具，从而增加其对私人投资者的吸引力并吸引私人资本。最后，我们的结果表明，在应对生物多样性危机方面，私人资本不太可能替代有效的公共政策。

31021.title: Intellectual Property Rights Design and Academic Innovation: Evidence from University Patent Ownership Reform
31021.zh_title: 知识产权制度设计与学术创新：来自大学专利所有权改革的证据
31021.zh_abstract_excerpt: 中国寻求促进大学专利的商业化，特别是通过“三权”改革和混合所有制改革。这两项改革采用了不同的大学专利所有权分配模式。“三权”改革将专利所有权完全分配给大学，而混合所有制方法则在成果产生后将大部分专利所有权分配给发明人。我们利用中国专利数据和大学统计数据，实证检验了两种专利所有权分配模式对专利绩效的影响。我们发现，外部制度环境影响了两种改革模式中改革试点的预期结果。
31021.abstract: China has sought to promote the commercialization of patents at universities, notably through the three rights and mixed ownership reforms. These two reforms adopted different models for the allocation of university patent ownership. The three rights reform completely allocates patent ownership to the universities, while the mixed ownership approach allocates the majority of patent ownership to the inventors upon the generation of outcomes. We empirically tested the effects of the two patent ownership allocation models on the patent performance using Chinese patent data and university statistics. We found that external institutional environment influenced the anticipated outcomes of the reform pilot in both reform models. The three rights reform has a significant impact on patent licensing without affecting the quantity or quality of patents, while the mixed ownership reform has significantly increased patent sales and applications while tilting research and development toward research with relatively low creativity. This paper contributes to the literature on innovation policies governing the conditions for effective institutional changes.

31020.title: A Trajectories-Based Approach to Measuring Intergenerational Mobility
31020.zh_title: 基于轨迹的代际流动性测量方法
31020.authors: Yoosoon Chang, Steven N. Durlauf, Seunghee Lee, Joon Y. Park
31020.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文提出了一种代际流动性的方法，其中儿童期和青少年期父母收入的轨迹是描述代际依赖关系的条件对象。我们使用函数回归方法生成一条代际弹性曲线，该曲线衡量每个年龄收入边际变化如何影响预期的后代永久收入。利用PSID数据，该曲线的估计值随年龄呈现近乎单调性，因此童年中期和青少年期的父母收入比童年早期收入具有更大的边际效应。
31020.abstract: This paper develops an approach to intergenerational mobility in which the trajectories of parental incomes during childhood and adolescence are the conditioning objects for characterizing dependence across generations. We use functional regression methods to produce an intergenerational elasticity curve that measures how marginal changes in income at each age affect expected offspring permanent income. Using the PSID, estimates of this curve exhibit near monotonicity with respect to age, so that parental incomes in middle childhood and adolescence have larger marginal effects than incomes in early childhood. When interactions are allowed to occur between incomes at different ages, we find a complex pattern of substitutability between incomes at ages that are close in time versus complementarity between parental incomes for ages early childhood and adolescence. Qualitatively similar results hold for offspring education while we do not find evidence of age-specific effects for occupation. We conclude that important information about the links between parental incomes and children exists beyond the scalar characterization of parental permanent income.

31019.title: Subjective Earnings Risk
31019.authors: Andrew Caplin, Victoria Gregory, Eungik Lee, Søren Leth-Petersen, Johan Sæverud
31019.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们引入了一种调查工具来衡量收入风险，该工具允许从当前工作中辞职或被解雇的可能性。我们发现这些转变是主观风险的关键驱动因素。与行政数据的链接为相应汇总数据提供了多重可信度检查。然而，它揭示了主观收入风险比传统估计所暗示的要小得多，即使在对人口统计特征和工作历史进行丰富条件设定时也是如此。一个校准以匹配工作转换和收入数据的生命周期搜索模型可以复制调查中报告的主观信念分布。
31019.abstract: We introduce a survey instrument to measure earnings risk allowing for the possibility of quitting or being fired from the current job. We find these transitions to be the key drivers of subjective risk. A link with administrative data provides multiple credibility checks for correspondingly aggregated data. Yet it reveals subjective earning risk to be many times smaller than traditional estimates imply even when conditioning richly on demographics and job history. A life-cycle search model calibrated to match data on job transitions and earnings can replicate the distribution of subjective beliefs reported in the survey. Job-match quality, which directly impacts subjective risk but is impossible to identify in administrative data, contributes significantly to earnings risk. This highlights the importance of administratively-linked subjective risk measures.

31018.title: The Simple Math of Royalties and Drug Competition During the 180-Day Generic Exclusivity Period
31018.zh_title: 版税与180天仿制药独占期内药品竞争的简单数学
31018.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在解决药品行业专利挑战的协议中，原告品牌方通常许可被告仿制药公司在专利到期前销售。一些协议要求仿制药公司向品牌方支付版税。尽管利润表面上流动，版税条款可能作为反竞争的“反向支付”的一部分，以换取延迟进入。通常，品牌方在首家仿制药公司的180天独占期内推出自己的授权仿制药，因此存在两个初始仿制药竞争者。一种阻止品牌方推出授权仿制药的版税结构将进入者数量减少到一个，向仿制药公司传递净价值，并可能诱使其延迟进入。
31018.abstract: In agreements settling patent challenges in the drug industry, the plaintiff brand commonly licenses the defendant generic to sell prior to patent expiry. Some agreements require the generic to pay the brand royalties. Despite the superficial flow of profits, royalty terms may function as part of an anticompetitive “reverse payment” made to the generic in exchange for delayed entry. Typically, the brand launches its own authorized generic (AG) during the first-to-file generic’s 180-day exclusivity period so there are two initial generic competitors. A royalty structure that deters the brand’s AG launch reduces the number of entrants to one, conveying net value to the generic and potentially inducing it to delay its entry. Our simple model shows that royalties usually have no place in a brand-generic agreement between rational actors. However, when royalties are conditioned on the brand’s AG launch, a range of royalty rates exists that both conveys net value to the generic and deters the brand from rationally introducing an AG. Declining royalty terms in a brand’s settlement with a first-to-file generic thus raise a red flag that the agreement is a pay-for-delay. Although the numbers are small, empirical analysis based on publicly available materials corroborates this conclusion.

31017.title: Machine Learning as a Tool for Hypothesis Generation
31017.zh_title: 机器学习作为假设生成的工具
31017.zh_abstract_excerpt: 虽然假设检验是一项高度形式化的活动，但假设生成在很大程度上仍然是非正式的。我们提出了一个系统性的程序来生成关于人类行为的新颖假设，该程序利用机器学习算法注意到人们可能注意不到的模式的能力。我们通过一个具体应用来说明该程序：法官关于监禁谁的决定。我们从一个惊人的事实开始：被告的面部本身对法官的监禁决定影响很大。事实上，仅根据被告面部照片像素的算法就解释了高达一半的可预测变异。
31017.abstract: While hypothesis testing is a highly formalized activity, hypothesis generation remains largely informal. We propose a systematic procedure to generate novel hypotheses about human behavior, which uses the capacity of machine learning algorithms to notice patterns people might not. We illustrate the procedure with a concrete application: judge decisions about who to jail. We begin with a striking fact: The defendant’s face alone matters greatly for the judge’s jailing decision. In fact, an algorithm given only the pixels in the defendant’s mugshot accounts for up to half of the predictable variation. We develop a procedure that allows human subjects to interact with this black-box algorithm to produce hypotheses about what in the face influences judge decisions. The procedure generates hypotheses that are both interpretable and novel: They are not explained by demographics (e.g. race) or existing psychology research; nor are they already known (even if tacitly) to people or even experts. Though these results are specific, our procedure is general. It provides a way to produce novel, interpretable hypotheses from any high-dimensional dataset (e.g. cell phones, satellites, online behavior, news headlines, corporate filings, and high-frequency time series). A central tenet of our paper is that hypothesis generation is in and of itself a valuable activity, and hope this encourages future work in this largely “pre-scientific” stage of science.
31017.zh_abstract: 虽然假设检验是一项高度形式化的活动，但假设生成在很大程度上仍然是非正式的。我们提出了一个系统性的程序来生成关于人类行为的新颖假设，该程序利用机器学习算法注意到人们可能注意不到的模式的能力。我们通过一个具体应用来说明该程序：法官关于监禁谁的决定。我们从一个惊人的事实开始：被告的面部本身对法官的监禁决定影响很大。事实上，仅根据被告面部照片像素的算法就解释了高达一半的可预测变异。我们开发了一个程序，允许人类受试者与这个黑箱算法互动，以生成关于面部什么因素影响法官决定的假设。该程序生成的假设既具有可解释性又具有新颖性：它们不能用人口统计特征（例如种族）或现有心理学研究来解释；它们也不是人们甚至专家已经知道的（即使是默会的）。尽管这些结果是具体的，但我们的程序是通用的。它提供了一种从任何高维数据集（例如手机、卫星、在线行为、新闻标题、公司文件和高频时间序列）中产生新颖、可解释假设的方法。我们论文的一个核心原则是，假设生成本身就是一项有价值的活动，并希望这能鼓励未来在这个科学的“前科学”阶段的工作。

31016.title: The Gendered Impacts of Perceived Skin Tone: Evidence from African-American Siblings in 1870–1940
31016.zh_title: 感知肤色的性别化影响：来自1870–1940年非裔美国兄弟姐妹的证据
31016.authors: Ran Abramitzky, Jacob Conway, Roy Mill, Luke Stein
31016.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用19世纪末至20世纪初的美国十年一次人口普查完整数据，研究了非裔美国人中因感知肤色不同而导致的经济结果差异。通过比较普查员标记为“黑人”或“混血”的儿童，并在历次人口普查中追踪这些儿童，我们首先发现，在感知肤色较深和较浅的非裔美国人之间，教育程度和收入存在巨大差距。为了厘清这些差距的驱动因素，我们识别出所有36,329个家庭，在这些家庭中，普查员对同性别的兄弟姐妹给予了不同的“黑人/混血”分类。
31016.abstract: We study differences in economic outcomes by perceived skin tone among African Americans using full-count U.S. decennial census data from the late-19th and early-20th centuries. Comparing children coded as “Black” or “Mulatto” by census enumerators and linking these children across population censuses, we first document large gaps in educational attainment and income among African Americans with darker and lighter perceived skin tones. To disentangle the drivers of these gaps, we identify all 36,329 families in which enumerators assigned same-gender siblings different Black/Mulatto classifications. Relative to sisters coded as Mulatto, sisters coded as Black had lower educational attainment, were less likely to marry, and had lower-earning, less-educated husbands. These patterns are consistent with more severe contemporaneous discrimination against African-American women with darker perceived skin tones. In contrast, we find similar educational attainment, marital outcomes, and incomes among differently-classified brothers. Men perceived as African Americans of any skin tone faced similar contemporaneous discrimination, consistent with the “one-drop” racial classification rule that grouped together individuals with any known Black ancestry. Lower incomes for African-American men perceived as having darker skin tone in the general population were driven by differences in opportunities and resources that varied across families, likely reflecting the impacts of historical or family-level discrimination
31016.zh_abstract: 我们利用19世纪末至20世纪初的美国十年一次人口普查完整数据，研究了非裔美国人中因感知肤色不同而导致的经济结果差异。通过比较普查员标记为“黑人”或“混血”的儿童，并在历次人口普查中追踪这些儿童，我们首先发现，在感知肤色较深和较浅的非裔美国人之间，教育程度和收入存在巨大差距。为了厘清这些差距的驱动因素，我们识别出所有36,329个家庭，在这些家庭中，普查员对同性别的兄弟姐妹给予了不同的“黑人/混血”分类。与被归类为“混血”的姐妹相比，被归类为“黑人”的姐妹教育程度较低，结婚可能性较小，且其丈夫收入较低、教育程度也较低。这些模式与当时对感知肤色较深的非裔美国女性存在更严重歧视的现象相一致。相比之下，我们发现被不同分类的兄弟在教育程度、婚姻结果和收入方面相似。任何肤色的非裔美国男性都面临着相似的即时歧视，这与“一滴血”种族分类规则一致，该规则将所有已知有任何非裔血统的个体归为一类。在总人口中，感知肤色较深的非裔美国男性收入较低，这主要是由不同家庭间机会和资源的差异所驱动，很可能反映了历史或家庭层面的歧视影响。

31015.title: Do Government Spending Multipliers Depend on the Sign of the Shock?
31015.zh_title: 政府支出乘数是否取决于冲击的方向？
31015.authors: Nadav Ben Zeev, Valerie A. Ramey, Sarah Zubairy
31015.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们分析了政府支出乘数是否因冲击方向的不同而存在差异。利用美国历史总量数据，我们应用Ben Zeev（2020）的非线性诊断检验，发现了政府支出和GDP的脉冲响应函数中存在非线性的证据。随后，我们扩展了Ramey和Zubairy（2018）的框架，允许将非对称效应作为一种状态依赖类型来估计乘数。虽然我们发现脉冲响应函数存在差异，但由此得出的乘数并不因冲击方向而不同。因此，我们没有发现政府支出乘数存在非对称性的证据。
31015.abstract: We analyze whether government spending multipliers differ by the sign of the shock. Using aggregate historical U.S. data, we apply Ben Zeev’s (2020) nonlinear diagnostic tests and find evidence of nonlinearities in the impulse response functions of both government spending and GDP. We then extend Ramey and Zubairy’s (2018) framework to allow for asymmetric effects as a type of state dependence to estimate multipliers. While we find differences in the impulse response functions, the resulting multipliers do not differ by sign of the shock. Thus, we find no evidence of asymmetry of government spending multipliers.

31014.title: A Human Capital Theory of Who Escapes the Grasp of the Local Monopsonist
31014.zh_title: 谁逃脱了本地买方垄断者的掌控：一个人力资本理论
31014.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在过去三十年中，衡量本地劳动力市场买方垄断势力的若干实证指标有所上升。买方垄断者有利润动机向本地工人提供更低的工资。流动的高技能工人可以通过迁移到其他更具竞争性、拥有更高技能价格向量的本地劳动力市场，来规避较低的买方垄断工资。我们提出了一个Roy模型，描述异质性工人在不同本地劳动力市场间的分类，该模型具有若干实证含义。预测买方垄断市场会随时间经历“人才流失”。利用跨越四十年的数据，我们记录了这种与本地买方垄断势力相关的技能退化现象。
31014.abstract: Over the last thirty years, there has been a rise in several empirical measures of local labor market monopsony power. The monopsonist has a profit incentive to offer lower wages to local workers. Mobile high skill workers can avoid the lower monopsony wages by moving to other more competitive local labor markets featuring a higher skill price vector. We present a Roy Model of heterogeneous worker sorting across local labor markets that has several empirical implications. Monopsony markets are predicted to experience a “brain drain” over time. Using data over four decades we document this deskilling associated with local monopsony power. This means that observed cross-sectional wage gaps in monopsony markets partially reflect sorting on worker ability. Going forward the rise of work from home may act as a substitute for high-skill worker migration from monopsony markets.

31013.title: House Prices and Rents in the 21st Century
31013.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了住宅物业价格和租金的联合演变。在构建了租赁和自有住宅的租金与价格指数后，我们将自住物业价格的变化分解为：（1）租金的变化，（2）投资者所有与自住物业相对价格的变化，以及（3）价格-租金比率的变化。通过一个简单模型，我们将分解结果与房价变动的不同来源联系起来。我们认为，虽然2000年代的繁荣似乎是由过度乐观的预期驱动的，但2020年代的繁荣更可能是由偏好冲击导致的。
31013.abstract: We study the joint evolution of prices and rents of residential property. After constructing rent and price indices for renter- and owner-occupied properties, we decompose the change in the price of occupant-owned property into (1) changes in rent, (2) changes in the relative prices of investor- and occupant-owned properties, and (3) changes in the price-rent ratio. Via a simple model, we link our decomposition to different sources of variation in house prices. We argue that while the 2000s boom was plausibly driven by exuberant expectations, the boom of the 2020s more likely resulted from a preference shock.

31012.title: The Great Migration and Educational Opportunity
31012.authors: Cavit Baran, Eric Chyn, Bryan A. Stuart
31012.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究了第一次大迁徙对儿童的影响。我们利用1940年完整人口普查数据，估算了经过选择偏差校正后的地点效应，以衡量其对黑人移民子女教育的影响。平均而言，黑人儿童通过从南方迁移到北方，获得了0.8年的额外教育（增幅12%）。许多在1940年代对儿童产生最强积极影响的县，如今为黑人青年提供的机会却相对较差。黑人儿童的机会在那些教育投资更多、黑人成人劳动力市场机会更强、社会资本更丰富以及犯罪率更低的地方更大。
31012.abstract: This paper studies the impact of the First Great Migration on children. We use the complete count 1940 Census to estimate selection-corrected place effects on education for children of Black migrants. On average, Black children gained 0.8 years of schooling (12 percent) by moving from the South to North. Many counties that had the strongest positive impacts on children during the 1940s offer relatively poor opportunities for Black youth today. Opportunities for Black children were greater in places with more schooling investment, stronger labor market opportunities for Black adults, more social capital, and less crime.

31011.title: Monitoring Harassment in Organizations
31011.authors: Laura E. Boudreau, Sylvain Chassang, Ada Gonzalez-Torres, Rachel M. Heath
31011.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们评估了旨在持续监控组织中骚扰行为的安全调查方法。我们利用由此产生的数据来回答关于骚扰本质的政策相关问题：其普遍程度如何？有多少管理者应对不当行为负责？受害者的孤立程度如何？为此，我们与一家大型孟加拉国服装制造商合作，对基于电话的工人调查的不同设计进行实验。通过自动将随机子集的回答记录为投诉来混淆对敏感问题的回答，使得身体骚扰的报告率增加了288%，性骚扰增加了269%，威胁行为增加了46%。
31011.abstract: We evaluate secure survey methods designed for the ongoing monitoring of harassment in organizations. We use the resulting data to answer policy relevant questions about the nature of harassment: How prevalent is it? What share of managers is responsible for the misbehavior? How isolated are its victims? To do so, we partner with a large Bangladeshi garment manufacturer to experiment with different designs of phone-based worker surveys. Garbling responses to sensitive questions by automatically recording a random subset as complaints increases reporting of physical harassment by 288%, sexual harassment by 269%, and threatening behavior by 46%. A rapport-building treatment has an insignificant aggregate effect, but may affect men and women differently. Removing team identifiers from survey responses does not significantly increase reporting and prevents the computation of policy-relevant team-level statistics. The resulting data shows that harassment is widespread, that the problem is not restricted to a minority of managers, and that victims are often isolated in teams.

31050.title: Liquidity Dependence and the Waxing and Waning of Central Bank Balance Sheets
31050.zh_title: 流动性依赖与中央银行资产负债表的扩张与收缩
31050.authors: Viral V. Acharya, Rahul S. Chauhan, Raghuram Rajan, Sascha Steffen
31050.zh_abstract_excerpt: 当美联储通过量化宽松（QE）扩大其资产负债表时，商业银行通常用无保险的活期存款来融资准备金持有。它们还向企业提供信贷额度。总体而言，这些银行发行的流动性债权在美联储停止QE并转向量化紧缩（QT）时并未相应缩减。因此，增加流动性风险敞口的银行——尤其是小型和地区性银行——变得容易受到流动性冲击的影响，需要美联储进一步提供流动性。证据表明，中央银行资产负债表的扩张和收缩导致了银行对中央银行的流动性依赖。
31050.abstract: When the Federal Reserve (Fed) expanded its balance sheet via quantitative easing (QE), commercial banks typically financed reserve holdings with uninsured demandable deposits. They also issued credit lines to corporations. In the aggregate, these bank-issued claims on liquidity did not shrink commensurately when the Fed halted QE and turned to quantitative tightening (QT). Consequently, banks that increased liquidity risk exposure – especially small and regional banks – became vulnerable to liquidity shocks, necessitating further liquidity provision by the Fed. The evidence suggests that the expansion and shrinkage of central bank balance sheets has led to liquidity dependence of banks on central banks.

31049.title: How Are Gender Norms Perceived?
31049.zh_title: 性别规范是如何被感知的？
31049.authors: Leonardo Bursztyn, Alexander W. Cappelen, Bertil Tungodden, Alessandra Voena, David H. Yanagizawa-Drott
31049.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文基于从60个国家新收集的具有全国代表性的数据，提供了关于性别规范误解的全球证据。我们确定误解在世界各地普遍存在。通过一个简单的概念框架，我们提供了证据表明性别刻板印象和对少数观点的过度加权是普遍存在的，并且似乎解释了误解的全球结构。实际支持和感知支持都被证明与相关的经济行为有关，包括女性就业和促进女性在领导层中代表性的行动。我们的论文表明，误解普遍存在，并可能在全球范围内塑造性别不平等。
31049.abstract: This paper provides global evidence on misperceptions of gender norms, drawing on newly collected, nationally representative data from 60 countries. We establish that misperceptions are pervasive across the world. Through a simple conceptual framework, we provide evidence that gender stereotyping and overweighting of minority views are ubiquitous and appear to account for the global structure of misperceptions. Both actual and perceived support are shown to be associated with relevant economic behaviors, including female employment and actions promoting women’s representation in leadership. Our paper suggests that misperceptions are ubiquitous and may shape gender inequality globally.

31048.title: Monetary Tightening and U.S. Bank Fragility in 2023: Mark-to-Market Losses and Uninsured Depositor Runs?
31048.zh_title: 2023年货币紧缩与美国银行脆弱性：按市值计价的损失与未保险存款人挤兑？
31048.authors: Erica Xuewei Jiang, Gregor Matvos, Tomasz Piskorski, Amit Seru
31048.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们构建了一个概念框架和一套实证方法论，用以分析利率上升对美国银行资产价值及银行稳定性的影响。我们对2022年第一季度至2023年第一季度期间因利率上升导致的银行资产价值进行按市值计价，结果显示平均下降了10%，总计约2万亿美元。我们提出了一个模型，说明即使银行资产完全具有流动性，利率上升导致的资产价值下降也可能引发自我实现的偿付能力挤兑。资产损失高、资本金低且关键的是未保险杠杆率高的银行最为脆弱。
31048.abstract: We develop a conceptual framework and an empirical methodology to analyze the effect of rising interest rates on the value of U.S. bank assets and bank stability. We mark-to-market the value of banks’ assets due to interest rate increases from Q1 2022 to Q1 2023, revealing an average decline of 10%, totaling about $\$2$ trillion in aggregate. We present a model illustrating how asset value declines due to higher rates can lead to self-fulfilling solvency runs even when banks’ assets are fully liquid. Banks with high asset losses, low capital, and, critically, high uninsured leverage are most fragile. A case study of the failed Silicon Valley Bank confirms the model insights. Our empirical measures of bank fragility suggest that, in the absence of regulatory intervention, many U.S. banks would have been at risk of self-fulfilling solvency runs.

31047.title: Complexity and Hyperbolic Discounting
31047.authors: Benjamin Enke, Thomas Graeber, Ryan Oprea
31047.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大量文献表明，人们对金钱奖励的贴现方式是双曲型的而非指数型的。尽管对金钱的贴现作为时间偏好的度量方式受到质疑，但它在实证实践中仍高度相关，并能预测广泛的实际行为，因此需要理解是什么导致了双曲贴现模式。我们提供的证据表明，双曲贴现反映了由评估延迟回报的复杂性所驱动的错误。具体而言，我们记录了双曲性（i）与选择不一致性和认知不确定性密切相关，（ii）在显性的复杂性操纵下会增加，并且（iii）在涉及无实际回报延迟的计算相似任务中几乎相同地出现。
31047.abstract: A large literature shows that people discount financial rewards hyperbolically instead of exponentially. While discounting of money has been questioned as a measure of time preferences, it continues to be highly relevant in empirical practice and predicts a wide range of real-world behaviors, creating a need to understand what generates the hyperbolic pattern. We provide evidence that hyperbolic discounting reflects mistakes that are driven by the complexity of evaluating delayed payoffs. In particular, we document that hyperbolicity (i) is strongly associated with choice inconsistency and cognitive uncertainty, (ii) increases in overt complexity manipulations and (iii) arises nearly identically in computationally similar tasks that involve no actual payoff delays. Our results suggest that even if people had exponential discount functions, complexity-driven mistakes would cause them to make hyperbolic choices. We examine which experimental techniques to estimate present bias are (not) confounded by complexity.

31046.title: Helicopter Drops and Liquidity Traps
31046.zh_title: 直升机撒钱与流动性陷阱
31046.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在流动性陷阱期间，由于名义利率已达到下限，货币供应量的增加没有实际效果。我们提出了一种理论，说明直升机撒钱如何在流动性陷阱期间发挥作用。我们构建了一个新凯恩斯主义货币模型，其中财政当局和货币当局是分离的，且后者面临资产负债表约束。如果货币当局能够承诺，即使在资产负债表约束下，流动性陷阱中也不需要直升机撒钱。然而，我们表明，当货币当局缺乏承诺能力时，直升机撒钱有助于稳定经济。
31046.abstract: During a liquidity trap, increases in the money supply have no real effects, as the nominal interest rate has reached its lower bound. We propose a theory of how helicopter drops of money can be effective during a liquidity trap. We develop a New Keynesian monetary model where the fiscal and monetary authorities are separated, and the latter faces balance sheet constraints. If the monetary authority can commit, helicopter drops are unnecessary in a liquidity trap, even under balance sheet constraints. However, we show that helicopter drops can help stabilize the economy when the monetary authority lacks commitment.

31045.title: From Syringes to Dishes: Improving Food Sufficiency through Vaccination
31045.zh_title: 从注射器到餐盘：通过疫苗接种改善食物充足性
31045.authors: Erkmen G. Aslim, Wei Fu, Erdal Tekin, Shijun You
31045.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文利用家庭脉搏调查数据，研究了新冠疫苗接种对美国食物不足的影响。我们的主要研究设计利用各州疫苗接种资格随时间变化的差异作为工具变量，以解决疫苗接种决策的内生性问题。我们发现，疫苗接种通过将食物不足的可能性降低24%，对食物困难产生了显著影响，在少数族裔和财务弱势群体中效果更强。这些结果在替代性设定和使用断点回归作为替代识别策略时依然稳健。
31045.abstract: This paper examines the impact of COVID-19 vaccination on food insufficiency in the United States, using data from the Household Pulse Survey. Our primary research design exploits variation in vaccine eligibility across states over time as an instrumental variable to address the endogeneity of vaccination decision. We find that vaccination had a substantial impact on food hardship by reducing the likelihood of food insufficiency by 24%, with even stronger effects among minority and financially disadvantaged populations. These results are robust to alternative specifications and the use of regression discontinuity as an alternative identification strategy. We also show that vaccine eligibility had a positive spillover impact on food assistance programs, notably reducing participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and the use of its benefits, suggesting that vaccination policies can help alleviate the government’s fiscal burden during public health crises. Our analysis offers detailed insights into the potential mechanisms linking vaccination to food insufficiency. We demonstrate that vaccination yields changes in both material circumstances and financial expectations. Specifically, vaccination increases the use of regular income for spending needs and reduces reports of insufficient food due to unaffordability. Additionally, we find that vaccination improves financial optimism, reflected in expectations for future employment income loss and the ability to meet mortgage and debt obligations. Our findings are consistent with the notion that this optimism, along with labor market recovery, diminished the need for precautionary savings, reduced reliance on government assistance, and encouraged household spending on essential goods like food, ultimately lowering food insufficiency.
31045.zh_abstract: 本文利用家庭脉搏调查数据，研究了新冠疫苗接种对美国食物不足的影响。我们的主要研究设计利用各州疫苗接种资格随时间变化的差异作为工具变量，以解决疫苗接种决策的内生性问题。我们发现，疫苗接种通过将食物不足的可能性降低24%，对食物困难产生了显著影响，在少数族裔和财务弱势群体中效果更强。这些结果在替代性设定和使用断点回归作为替代识别策略时依然稳健。我们还表明，疫苗接种资格对食物援助计划产生了正向溢出效应，显著减少了补充营养援助计划的参与及其福利使用，表明疫苗接种政策有助于在公共卫生危机期间减轻政府的财政负担。我们的分析详细揭示了疫苗接种与食物不足之间的潜在机制。我们证明，疫苗接种带来了物质状况和财务预期的变化。具体而言，疫苗接种增加了使用常规收入满足支出需求的情况，并减少了因无力负担而导致食物不足的报告。此外，我们发现疫苗接种改善了财务乐观情绪，这体现在对未来就业收入损失以及偿还抵押贷款和债务能力的预期上。我们的发现与以下观点一致：这种乐观情绪，加上劳动力市场的复苏，减少了对预防性储蓄的需求，降低了对政府援助的依赖，并鼓励了家庭在食品等必需品上的支出，最终降低了食物不足。

31044.title: Global High-Resolution Estimates of the United Nations Human Development Index Using Satellite Imagery and Machine-learning
31044.zh_title: 利用卫星图像和机器学习对联合国人类发展指数进行全球高分辨率估算
31044.authors: Luke Sherman, Jonathan Proctor, Hannah Druckenmiller, Heriberto Tapia, Solomon M. Hsiang
31044.zh_abstract_excerpt: 联合国人类发展指数可以说是衡量国家发展方面最广泛使用的国内生产总值替代指标。这在很大程度上归因于其多维性质，因为它不仅包含收入，还包含教育和健康。然而，联合国开发计划署人类发展报告办公室发布的全球人类发展指数数据仅限于国家层面（N=191个国家），这限制了其在地方层面的使用。最近的研究利用调查数据对一级行政单位（如州/省）的人类发展指数进行了估算。
31044.abstract: The United Nations Human Development Index (HDI) is arguably the most widely used alternative to gross domestic product for measuring national development. This is in large part due to its multidimensional nature, as it incorporates not only income, but also education and health. However, the country-level resolution of the global HDI data released by the Human Development Report Office of the United Nations Development Programme (N=191 countries) has limited its use at the local level. Recent efforts used survey data to produce HDI estimates for first-level administrative units (e.g., states/provinces). Here, we build on recent advances in machine learning and satellite imagery to develop the first global estimates of HDI for second-level administrative units (e.g., municipalities/counties, N = 61,530) and for a global 0.1° × 0.1° grid (N=819,309). To accomplish this we develop and validate a generalizable downscaling technique based on satellite imagery that allows for training and prediction with observations of arbitrary shape and size. This enables us to train a model using provincial administrative data and generate HDI estimates at the municipality and grid levels. Our results indicate that more than half of the global population was previously assigned to the incorrect HDI quintile within each country, due to aggregation bias resulting from lower resolution estimates. We also illustrate how these data can improve decision-making. We make these high-resolution HDI estimates publicly available in the hope that they increase understanding of human wellbeing globally and improve the effectiveness of policies supporting sustainable development. We also make available the satellite features necessary to increase the spatial resolution of any other administrative data that is detectable via imagery.

31043.title: The Last Mile of Monetary Policy: Inattention, Reminders, and the Refinancing Channel
31043.zh_title: 货币政策的最后一公里：注意力不足、提醒与再融资渠道
31043.authors: Shane Byrne, Kenneth Devine, Michael King, Yvonne McCarthy, Christopher Palmer
31043.zh_abstract_excerpt: 再融资不足限制了宽松货币政策向家庭部门的传导，并每年使许多国家的抵押贷款持有人损失相当大比例的收入。我们通过与一家大型银行合作，分析一项针对12,000个爱尔兰家庭发送信息的实地实验，检验有针对性的沟通能否减少阻碍传导的注意力摩擦。虽然我们发现披露设计改进的效果很小，但一封提醒信使再融资率从8.9%提高到15.7%，增加了76%。为了解释这种提醒效应，我们扩展并估计了一个注意力不足的金融决策混合模型，以允许披露处理对注意力的影响。
31043.abstract: Under-refinancing limits the transmission of accommodative monetary policy to the household sector and costs mortgage holders in many countries a significant fraction of income annually. We test whether targeted communication can reduce the attention frictions that inhibit transmission by partnering with a large bank to analyze a field experiment testing messages sent to 12,000 Irish households. While we find only small effects of disclosure design improvements, a reminder letter increases refinancing by 76%, from 8.9% to 15.7%. To interpret this reminder effect, we extend and estimate a mixture model of inattentive financial decision-making to allow for disclosure treatment effects on attention. We find that reminders increase the likelihood mortgage holders are attentive by over 60%, from 24% to 39%. A conservative back-of-the-envelope cost-effectiveness calculation implies that the average reminder letter generated €42 of mortgagor consumption (€605 per refinancing household). Our results illustrate that targeted central bank communication such as refinancing reminders could have a larger effect on refinancing than a standard policy rate cut. Reminders could further strengthen the refinancing channel and stimulate local consumption even when policy rates are at the zero-lower bound or set in a monetary union.

31042.title: Pivotal or Popular: The Effects of Social Information and Feeling Pivotal on Civic Actions
31042.zh_title: 关键还是受欢迎：社会信息与感觉关键对公民行为的影响
31042.authors: Laura K. Gee, Anoushka Kiyawat, Jonathan Meer, Michael J. Schreck
31042.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们通过测试人们在自身行为是否关键以及行为受欢迎程度不同情况下的反应，来研究受欢迎程度和感觉对达成目标的重要性两者的综合效应。我们进行了一项实验室实验，以清晰地固定人们对自身在达到触发配捐的捐赠门槛时是否关键的信念，同时改变关键性和其他捐赠者的数量（受欢迎程度）。结果令人瞩目，那些行为关键的人进行捐赠的可能性是其他人的两倍以上。随后，我们进行了两项实地实验，以在现实世界中检验这些发现。我们的结果表明，关键性是亲社会行为的更重要决定因素。
31042.abstract: We examine the combined effects of popularity and feelings of being important to reaching a goal by testing how people react to situations in which their own behavior is pivotal or not, as well as the popularity of the action. We conduct a laboratory experiment to cleanly fix beliefs about the person's likelihood of being pivotal in reaching a donation threshold that triggers a matching gift, varying both the pivotality and the number of other donors (popularity). The results are striking, with those whose action is pivotal being more than twice as likely to make a donation. We then conduct two field experiments to test these findings in real-world settings. Our results suggest that pivotality is a more important determinant of prosocial behavior.

31041.title: Personality Differences and Investment Decision-Making
31041.authors: Zhengyang Jiang, Cameron Peng, Hongjun Yan
31041.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们对数千名富裕的美国投资者进行了调查，以研究人格与投资决策之间的关系。大五人格特质与投资者对股市和经济的信念、风险偏好以及社交互动倾向相关。其中，神经质和开放性这两个人格特质在解释股权投资方面尤为突出。神经质高和开放性低的投资者倾向于将较少的投资配置于股票。我们考察了潜在机制，并发现了偏好和信念的标准渠道以及其他非标准渠道的证据。我们在澳大利亚和德国家庭的代表性面板数据中展示了一致的样本外证据。
31041.abstract: We survey thousands of affluent American investors to examine the relationship between personalities and investment decisions. The Big Five personality traits correlate with investors' beliefs about the stock market and economy, risk preferences, and social interaction tendencies. Two personality traits, Neuroticism and Openness, stand out in their explanatory power for equity investments. Investors with high Neuroticism and those with low Openness tend to allocate less investment to equities. We examine the underlying mechanisms and find evidence for both standard channels of preferences and beliefs and other nonstandard channels. We show consistent out-of-sample evidence in representative panels of Australian and German households.

31040.title: A User's Guide to Inference in Models Defined by Moment Inequalities
31040.zh_title: 矩不等式定义模型推断的用户指南
31040.authors: Ivan Canay, Gastón Illanes, Amilcar Velez
31040.zh_abstract_excerpt: 由矩不等式定义的模型已成为实证经济学家的标准建模框架，广泛覆盖经济学内的多个领域。从实证研究者的角度来看，关于矩不等式模型推断的文献庞大且复杂，包括多篇综述论文，这些论文记录了这些模型所具有的非标准特征、这些模型推断背后的主要新概念，以及带来准确性和计算易处理性进步的最新发展。在本文中，我们提供了一份实证实践指南，旨在帮助应用研究者驾驭将模型构建为矩不等式模型所需的所有决策，然后为感兴趣的参数构建置信区间。
31040.abstract: Models defined by moment inequalities have become a standard modeling framework for empirical economists, spreading over a wide range of fields within economics. From the point of view of an empirical researcher, the literature on inference in moment inequality models is large and complex, including multiple survey papers that document the non-standard features these models possess, the main novel concepts behind inference in these models, and the most recent developments that bring advances in accuracy and computational tractability. In this paper we present a guide to empirical practice intended to help applied researchers navigate all the decisions required to frame a model as a moment inequality model and then to construct confidence intervals for the parameters of interest. We divide our template into four main steps: (a) a behavioral decision model, (b) moving from the decision model to a moment inequality model, (c) choosing a test statistic and critical value, and (d) accounting for computational challenges. We split each of these steps into a discussion of the “how” and the “why”, and then illustrate how to take these steps to practice in an empirical application that studies identification of expected sunk costs of offering a product in a market.

31039.title: Fortunate Families? The Effects of Wealth on Marriage and Fertility
31039.zh_title: 幸运的家庭？财富对婚姻和生育的影响
31039.authors: David Cesarini, Erik Lindqvist, Robert Östling, Anastasia Terskaya
31039.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用瑞典彩票中奖者样本，估计了巨大的正向财富冲击对婚姻和生育的影响。对于男性中奖者，财富增加了婚姻形成并降低了离婚风险，这表明财富提高了男性作为潜在和现任伴侣的吸引力。财富也增加了男性的生育率。对女性中奖者唯一可观察到的影响是，财富增加了其短期（而非长期）离婚风险。我们的离婚结果与一个模型一致，在该模型中，较富有的配偶在离婚时保留其大部分财富。为支持这一假设，我们表明瑞典的离婚协议通常偏向较富有的配偶。
31039.abstract: We estimate the effects of large, positive wealth shocks on marriage and fertility in a sample of Swedish lottery players. For male winners, wealth increases marriage formation and reduces divorce risk, suggesting wealth increases men’s attractiveness as prospective and current partners. Wealth also increases male fertility. The only discernible effect on female winners is that wealth increases their short-run (but not long-run) divorce risk. Our results for divorce are consistent with a model where the wealthier spouse retains most of his/her wealth in divorce. In support of this assumption, we show divorce settlements in Sweden often favor the richer spouse.

31038.title: Longevity, Health and Housing Risks Management in Retirement
31038.zh_title: 退休后的长寿、健康与住房风险管理
31038.zh_abstract_excerpt: 年金、长期护理保险和反向抵押贷款在管理退休后的长寿、健康和住房价格风险方面仍然出奇地不受欢迎。我们利用一个独特的加拿大家庭陈述偏好调查实验，通过结构估计的灵活生命周期模型来分析这种缺乏兴趣的原因。高风险厌恶、对不确定性早期解决的偏好、对残疾状态估值的强烈折现、住房可替代性以及遗赠动机，在解释大部分有限需求方面起着关键作用。剩余的不感兴趣则由信息摩擦和惯性来解释。我们还记录了公共挤出效应、配偶共同保险以及对产品捆绑的响应性的证据。
31038.abstract: Annuities, long-term care insurance and reverse mortgages remain puzzlingly unpopular to manage post-retirement longevity, health and housing price risks. We analyze the lack of interest using a flexible life-cycle model structurally estimated with a unique stated-preference survey experiment of Canadian households. High risk aversion, preference for early resolution of uncertainty, strong discounting of valuation in disability states, housing substitutability and bequest motives play key roles in explaining most of the limited demand. The remaining disinterest is accounted for by information frictions and inertia. We also document evidence of public crowding out, spousal co-insurance and of responsiveness to products bundling.

31037.title: Exploring European Regional Trade
31037.authors: Marta A. Santamaría, Jaume Ventura, Uğur Yeşilbayraktar
31037.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用Santamaría等人（2020）构建的涵盖24个国家269个欧洲区域的贸易流新数据集，首次系统地探索了国家边界内外的贸易模式。我们重点关注国内贸易、国家内贸易和国外贸易之间的差异。我们记录了以下事实：(i) 欧洲区域贸易具有强烈的国内和国家偏向，(ii) 地理距离和国家边界是区域贸易的重要决定因素，但无法解释强烈的区域国内偏向，以及 (iii) 国内偏向在不同区域间存在异质性，似乎由政治区域边界驱动。
31037.abstract: We use the new dataset of trade flows across 269 European regions in 24 countries constructed in Santamaría et al. (2020) to systematically explore for the first time trade patterns within and across country borders. We focus on the differences between home trade, country trade and foreign trade. We document the following facts: (i) European regional trade has a strong home and country bias, (ii) geographic distance and national borders are important determinants of regional trade, but cannot explain the strong regional home bias and (iii) the home bias is heterogeneous across regions and seems to be driven by political regional borders.
31037.zh_abstract: 我们使用Santamaría等人（2020）构建的涵盖24个国家269个欧洲区域的贸易流新数据集，首次系统地探索了国家边界内外的贸易模式。我们重点关注国内贸易、国家内贸易和国外贸易之间的差异。我们记录了以下事实：(i) 欧洲区域贸易具有强烈的国内和国家偏向，(ii) 地理距离和国家边界是区域贸易的重要决定因素，但无法解释强烈的区域国内偏向，以及 (iii) 国内偏向在不同区域间存在异质性，似乎由政治区域边界驱动。

31036.title: Information Favoritism and Scoring Bias in Contests
31036.zh_title: 竞赛中的信息偏袒与评分偏差
31036.authors: Shanglyu Deng, Hanming Fang, Qiang Fu, Zenan Wu
31036.zh_abstract_excerpt: 两个潜在不对称的参与者通过付出努力，竞争一个最初未知的共同价值奖品。设计者拥有两个竞赛设计工具。首先，她决定是否以及如何向参与者披露关于奖品价值的信息信号。其次，她设定竞赛的评分规则，该规则改变参与者的相对竞争力。我们表明，最优方案取决于设计者的目标。双边对称竞赛——其中信息对称分布，且评分偏差被设定以抵消参与者之间的初始不对称——总是最大化预期总努力。
31036.abstract: Two potentially asymmetric players compete for a prize of common value, which is initially unknown, by exerting efforts. A designer has two instruments for contest design. First, she decides whether and how to disclose an informative signal of the prize value to players. Second, she sets the scoring rule of the contest, which varies the relative competitiveness of the players. We show that the optimum depends on the designer’s objective. A bilateral symmetric contest—in which information is symmetrically distributed and the scoring bias is set to offset the initial asymmetry between players—always maximizes the expected total effort. However, the optimal contest may deliberately create bilateral asymmetry—which discloses the signal privately to one player, while favoring the other in terms of the scoring rule—when the designer is concerned about the expected winner’s effort. The two instruments thus exhibit complementarity, in that the optimum can be made asymmetric in both dimensions even if the players are ex ante symmetric. Our results are qualitatively robust to (i) affiliated signals and (ii) endogenous information structure. We show that information favoritism can play a useful role in addressing affirmative action objectives.
31036.zh_abstract: 两个潜在不对称的参与者通过付出努力，竞争一个最初未知的共同价值奖品。设计者拥有两个竞赛设计工具。首先，她决定是否以及如何向参与者披露关于奖品价值的信息信号。其次，她设定竞赛的评分规则，该规则改变参与者的相对竞争力。我们表明，最优方案取决于设计者的目标。双边对称竞赛——其中信息对称分布，且评分偏差被设定以抵消参与者之间的初始不对称——总是最大化预期总努力。然而，当设计者关注预期获胜者的努力时，最优竞赛可能故意制造双边不对称——即私下向一个参与者披露信号，同时在评分规则上偏袒另一个参与者。因此，这两个工具表现出互补性，因为即使参与者在事前是对称的，最优方案也可能在两个维度上都是不对称的。我们的结果在定性上对 (i) 关联信号和 (ii) 内生信息结构是稳健的。我们表明，信息偏袒可以在解决平权行动目标方面发挥有益作用。

31035.title: Dying or Lying? For-Profit Hospices and End of Life Care
31035.zh_title: 临终或谎言？营利性临终关怀与临终护理
31035.authors: Jonathan Gruber, David H. Howard, Jetson Leder-Luis, Theodore L. Caputi
31035.zh_abstract_excerpt: 医疗保险临终关怀项目旨在为临终患者提供姑息治疗，但长期住院的临终关怀患者利润丰厚，这引发了人们对阿尔茨海默病和相关痴呆症（ADRD）人群在快速增长的营利性部门中过度使用的担忧。我们利用二十多年来营利性临终关怀机构的进入，首次提供了关于营利性临终关怀对患者支出影响的因果估计。我们发现，临终关怀通过抵消ADRD患者其他昂贵的护理费用，为医疗保险节省了资金。
31035.abstract: The Medicare hospice program is intended to provide palliative care to terminal patients, but patients with long stays in hospice are highly profitable, motivating concerns about overuse among the Alzheimer’s and Dementia (ADRD) population in the rapidly growing for-profit sector. We provide the first causal estimates of the effect of for-profit hospice on patient spending using the entry of for-profit hospices over twenty years. We find hospice has saved money for Medicare by offsetting other expensive care among ADRD patients. As a result, policies limiting hospice use including revenue caps and anti-fraud lawsuits are distortionary and deter cost-saving admissions.
31035.zh_abstract: 医疗保险临终关怀项目旨在为临终患者提供姑息治疗，但长期住院的临终关怀患者利润丰厚，这引发了人们对阿尔茨海默病和相关痴呆症（ADRD）人群在快速增长的营利性部门中过度使用的担忧。我们利用二十多年来营利性临终关怀机构的进入，首次提供了关于营利性临终关怀对患者支出影响的因果估计。我们发现，临终关怀通过抵消ADRD患者其他昂贵的护理费用，为医疗保险节省了资金。因此，限制临终关怀使用的政策，包括收入上限和反欺诈诉讼，具有扭曲性，并阻碍了节省成本的入院。

31034.title: Intergenerational Transmission of Lifespan in the US
31034.authors: Sandra E. Black, Neil Duzett, Adriana Lleras-Muney, Nolan G. Pope, Joseph Price
31034.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用一个包含超过2600万出生于1880年至1920年间个体的独特数据集，考察了寿命的代际传递。我们记录了关于寿命绝对和相对流动性的新事实。平均而言，在各队列中，47%的男性和57%的女性比其父母活得更长，尽管这在不同队列间存在差异。相对指标显示出更高的流动性，且随时间及子人群的变化显著较小。寿命的代际相关性（衡量持续性而非流动性）对两性而言约为0.09——这种低相关性在种族、教育群体、队列和出生州中均被观察到。
31034.abstract: We examine the transmission of lifespan across generations using a unique dataset containing more than 26 million individuals born between 1880 and 1920. We document new facts about the absolute and relative mobility in lifespan. On average across cohorts, 47% of men and 57 percent of women lived longer than their parents, though this varied across cohorts. Relative measures show higher mobility, with substantially less variation across time and subpopulations. The intergenerational correlation in lifespan (a measure of persistence rather than mobility) is about 0.09 for both sexes – this low correlation is observed across races, education groups, cohorts, and birth states. Finally, we document that the intergenerational persistence of lifespan is much smaller than the persistence in socio-economic status. Moreover, correlations in lifespan and in education are largely independent of each other, suggesting that mobility in well-being may be larger than measures of income alone suggest.

31033.title: Information Heterogeneity and the Demand for Healthcare: Evidence from GPs in England
31033.zh_title: 信息与医疗质量差异：来自英格兰全科医生选择的证据
31033.authors: Zach Y. Brown, Christopher Hansman, Jordan Keener, Andre F. Veiga
31033.abstract: Why do low income patients tend to go to lower quality health care providers, even when they are free? We show that differential information about provider quality is an important determinant of this disparity. Our empirical strategy exploits the temporary presence of a website that publicly displayed summary star ratings of general practitioner (GP) offices in England. Regression discontinuity estimates show that patient demand responds sharply to the information on the website, and that this response is almost entirely driven by residents of low income neighborhoods. The results are consistent with high income patients having better private information about quality. We incorporate our estimates into a structural model of demand that allows for heterogeneity in information, preferences, and consumer inertia. We find that information differences explain 24 percent of the relationship between income and GP quality and reinforce disparities in access to care.
31033.zh_abstract: 为什么低收入患者即使面对免费医疗，也倾向于选择质量较低的医疗服务提供者？我们表明，关于提供者质量的差异化信息是这种差异的一个重要决定因素。我们的实证策略利用了英格兰一个临时存在的网站，该网站公开显示全科医生诊所的摘要星级评分。断点回归估计显示，患者需求对网站上的信息反应剧烈，并且这种反应几乎完全由低收入社区的居民驱动。这些结果与高收入患者拥有更好的关于质量的私人信息这一情况一致。我们将估计结果纳入一个允许信息、偏好和消费者惯性存在异质性的结构性需求模型。我们发现，信息差异解释了收入与全科医生质量之间关系的24%，并加剧了护理获取方面的差异。

31032.title: Weighted Median Inflation Around the World: A Measure of Core Inflation
31032.zh_title: 全球加权中位数通胀：一种核心通胀衡量指标
31032.authors: Laurence M. Ball, Carlos Carvalho, Christopher Evans, Luca Antonio Ricci
31032.zh_abstract_excerpt: 衡量核心通胀或潜在通胀的标准指标是剔除食品和能源价格后的通胀率。本文利用1990-2021年期间38个发达经济体和新兴经济体的CPI子类细分数据，构建了另一种衡量指标——加权中位数通胀率，并将其性质与标准核心通胀进行了比较。对于季度数据，我们发现加权中位数通胀比标准核心通胀波动性更小，与经济疲软程度的相关性更强，并且与未来一年的整体通胀相关性更强。加权中位数通胀也存在一个缺点：在大多数国家，其平均水平低于整体通胀。
31032.abstract: The standard measure of core or underlying inflation is the inflation rate excluding food and energy prices. This paper constructs an alternative measure, the weighted median inflation rate, for 38 advanced and emerging economies using subclass level disaggregation of the CPI over 1990-2021, and compares the properties of this measure to those of standard core. For quarterly data, we find that the weighted median is less volatile than standard core, more closely related to economic slack, and more closely related to headline inflation over the next year. The weighted median also has a drawback: in most countries, it has a lower average level than headline inflation. We therefore also consider a measure of core inflation that eliminates this bias, which is based on the percentile of sectoral inflation rates that matches the sample average of headline CPI inflation.
31032.zh_abstract: 衡量核心通胀或潜在通胀的标准指标是剔除食品和能源价格后的通胀率。本文利用1990-2021年期间38个发达经济体和新兴经济体的CPI子类细分数据，构建了另一种衡量指标——加权中位数通胀率，并将其性质与标准核心通胀进行了比较。对于季度数据，我们发现加权中位数通胀比标准核心通胀波动性更小，与经济疲软程度的相关性更强，并且与未来一年的整体通胀相关性更强。加权中位数通胀也存在一个缺点：在大多数国家，其平均水平低于整体通胀。因此，我们还考虑了一种消除这种偏差的核心通胀衡量指标，该指标基于与整体CPI通胀样本均值相匹配的行业通胀率百分位数。

31031.title: Sentiment, Productivity, and Economic Growth
31031.zh_title: 情绪、生产率与经济增长
31031.authors: George M. Constantinides, Maurizio Montone, Valerio Potì, Stella Spilioti
31031.zh_abstract_excerpt: 先前的研究发现情绪与未来经济增长之间存在相关性，但对于解释这一结果的传导渠道存在分歧。在本文中，我们通过利用情绪和市场效率的跨国差异，为这一问题提供了新的见解。我们发现，七国集团国家的情绪冲击会增加经济活动，但只是暂时的，且不影响生产率。相比之下，非七国集团国家的情绪冲击预示着持续的经济增长以及相应的生产率提升。结果表明，情绪确实可以创造经济繁荣，但仅限于那些资产价格噪音较大、使得情绪与基本面更难区分的欠发达经济体。
31031.abstract: Previous research finds correlation between sentiment and future economic growth, but disagrees on the channel that explains this result. In this paper, we shed new light on this issue by exploiting cross-country variation in sentiment and market efficiency. We find that sentiment shocks in G7 countries increase economic activity, but only temporarily and without affecting productivity. By contrast, sentiment shocks in non-G7 countries predict prolonged economic growth and a corresponding increase in productivity. The results suggest that sentiment can indeed create economic booms, but only in less advanced economies where noisy asset prices make sentiment and fundamentals harder to disentangle.
31031.zh_abstract: 先前的研究发现情绪与未来经济增长之间存在相关性，但对于解释这一结果的传导渠道存在分歧。在本文中，我们通过利用情绪和市场效率的跨国差异，为这一问题提供了新的见解。我们发现，七国集团国家的情绪冲击会增加经济活动，但只是暂时的，且不影响生产率。相比之下，非七国集团国家的情绪冲击预示着持续的经济增长以及相应的生产率提升。结果表明，情绪确实可以创造经济繁荣，但仅限于那些资产价格噪音较大、使得情绪与基本面更难区分的欠发达经济体。

31030.title: Market Size and Trade in Medical Services
31030.zh_title: 市场规模与医疗服务贸易
31030.authors: Jonathan I. Dingel, Joshua D. Gottlieb, Maya Lozinski, Pauline Mourot
31030.abstract: We uncover substantial interregional trade in medical services and investigate whether regional increasing returns explain it. In Medicare data, one-fifth of production involves a doctor treating a patient from another region. Larger regions produce greater quantity, quality, and variety of medical services, which they “export” to patients from elsewhere, especially smaller regions. We show that these patterns reflect scale economies: greater demand enables larger regions to improve quality, so they attract patients from elsewhere. Despite concerns about rural access, larger regions have higher marginal returns to spending. We study counterfactual policies that would lower travel costs rather than relocating production.
31030.zh_abstract: 我们发现了大量的医疗服务跨区域贸易，并研究了区域性的规模报酬递增是否是其成因。在医疗保险数据中，五分之一的医疗服务涉及医生治疗来自其他地区的患者。规模较大的地区提供数量更多、质量更高、种类更丰富的医疗服务，并将其“出口”给来自其他地区（尤其是较小地区）的患者。我们表明，这些模式反映了规模经济：更大的需求使较大地区能够提高质量，从而吸引来自其他地区的患者。尽管存在对农村地区可及性的担忧，但较大地区的支出边际回报更高。我们研究了降低旅行成本而非转移生产布局的反事实政策。

31066.title: The March 2023 Bank Interventions in Long-Run Context – Silicon Valley Bank and beyond
31066.zh_title: 2023年3月银行干预措施的长期背景——硅谷银行及其后
31066.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国和欧洲的银行机构在2023年3月遭遇了一波困境。大西洋两岸的政策制定者采取了一系列干预措施，有些针对个别机构，有些旨在支撑整个银行业。本文利用过去八个世纪银行业政策干预的新长期数据库，将这些事件置于背景中。基于此，近期的行动在其政策组合和规模上已经不同寻常——在该数据库中，绝大多数具有相同干预模式的事件最终演变成了“系统性”银行困境事件。
31066.abstract: U.S. and European banking institutions were hit by a wave of distress in March 2023. Policymakers on both sides of the Atlantic reacted with an array of interventions, some targeting individual institutions, others designed to shore up the banking sector as a whole. This paper contextualizes events using a new long-run database on banking-sector policy interventions over the last eight centuries. On that basis, recent actions have already been unusual in their policy mix and size – in the database, the vast majority of events with the same pattern of interventions ultimately evolved into “systemic” bank-distress episodes.
31066.zh_abstract: 美国和欧洲的银行机构在2023年3月遭遇了一波困境。大西洋两岸的政策制定者采取了一系列干预措施，有些针对个别机构，有些旨在支撑整个银行业。本文利用过去八个世纪银行业政策干预的新长期数据库，将这些事件置于背景中。基于此，近期的行动在其政策组合和规模上已经不同寻常——在该数据库中，绝大多数具有相同干预模式的事件最终演变成了“系统性”银行困境事件。

31065.title: Information Technology, Firm Size, and Industrial Concentration
31065.zh_title: 信息技术、企业规模与产业集中度
31065.authors: Erik Brynjolfsson, Wang Jin, Georgios Petropoulos, Xiupeng Wang
31065.zh_abstract_excerpt: 信息技术（IT）有可能重塑企业组织和市场结构。本文构建了一个古诺竞争模型，在该模型中，IT使企业能够将其效率最高的工厂的运营流程复制到各个地点。这导致了边际生产成本的下降和“无规模扩张”的结果：由于IT的采用，企业收入的增长快于就业的增长。利用涵盖约5000家企业面板数据的美国人口普查微观数据，我们证实，IT投资增加与销售额和市场集中度的上升相关，而对就业的影响则较小且更不明确。工具变量和长期差分模型的结果表明，这种关联是因果性的。
31065.abstract: Information technologies (IT) have the potential to reshape the organization of firms and the structure of markets. In this paper, we develop a Cournot competition model in which IT enables firms to replicate the routines of their most efficient establishment across locations. This leads to a decline in marginal cost production and the “scale without mass” outcome: because of IT adoption, firms’ revenue grows faster than employment. Drawing on US Census microdata covering a panel of about 5000 firms, we confirm that greater investment in IT is associated with increases in sales and market concentration, with smaller and more ambiguous effects on employment. Results from instrumental variables and long-difference models suggest that the association is causal. Because the effect of IT is more pronounced on sales than employment, it compresses the labor share. We also show that IT disproportionately benefits larger firms by enhancing their ability to scale and replicate their operational processes across multiple establishments, markets, and industry segments. By pinpointing how firms operationalize IT gains through replicating high-efficiency routines across establishments, our model and analysis deepen our understanding of the micro-foundation behind recent macro evidence on rising concentration and declining labor share in the digital era.
31065.zh_abstract: 信息技术（IT）有可能重塑企业组织和市场结构。本文构建了一个古诺竞争模型，在该模型中，IT使企业能够将其效率最高的工厂的运营流程复制到各个地点。这导致了边际生产成本的下降和“无规模扩张”的结果：由于IT的采用，企业收入的增长快于就业的增长。利用涵盖约5000家企业面板数据的美国人口普查微观数据，我们证实，IT投资增加与销售额和市场集中度的上升相关，而对就业的影响则较小且更不明确。工具变量和长期差分模型的结果表明，这种关联是因果性的。由于IT对销售额的影响比就业更显著，它压低了劳动收入份额。我们还表明，IT通过增强大型企业跨多个工厂、市场和行业细分领域扩展和复制其运营流程的能力，使其不成比例地受益。通过精确指出企业如何通过跨工厂复制高效运营流程来实现IT收益，我们的模型和分析加深了我们对数字时代集中度上升和劳动收入份额下降等近期宏观证据背后微观基础的理解。

31064.title: The Value of Ratings: Evidence from their Introduction in Securities Markets
31064.zh_title: 评级的价值：来自证券市场引入评级的证据
31064.authors: Asaf Bernstein, Carola Frydman, Eric Hilt
31064.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了公司证券首次评级的效应。1909年，约翰·穆迪出版了一本书，根据他对信用风险的评估，将大多数上市铁路债券划分为字母等级评级。这些评级没有监管含义，并且很大程度上可以用公开信息来解释。尽管如此，我们发现，低于市场隐含评级的评级导致了二级市场债券收益率的上升。利用工具变量设计，我们表明，获得评级的债券其买卖价差出现了显著下降，这与信息不对称减少和流动性改善是一致的。
31064.abstract: We study the effects of the first-ever ratings for corporate securities. In 1909, John Moody published a book that partitioned the majority of listed railroad bonds into letter-graded ratings based on his assessments of their credit risk. These ratings had no regulatory implications and were largely explainable using publicly available information. Despite this, we find that lower than market-implied ratings caused a rise in secondary market bond yields. Using an instrumental-variables design, we show that bonds that were rated experienced a substantial decline in their bid-ask spreads, which is consistent with reduced information asymmetries and improved liquidity. Our findings suggest that ratings can improve information transmission, even in settings with the highest monetary stakes, and highlight their potential value for the functioning of financial markets.

31063.title: Difference-in-Differences with Unequal Baseline Treatment Status
31063.zh_title: 基线处理状态不等的双重差分法
31063.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了一个双重差分（DiD）框架，其中各群体在政策变化前时期经历了不平等的处理状态。这种方法在实证研究中常用，但与经典模型的假设相矛盾。我们表明，在这种情况下，除非处理效应是即时且随时间恒定的，否则标准的DiD方法无法恢复平均处理效应（ATT）。此外，通常的平行趋势检验是无效的，这意味着当平行趋势假设成立时可能发现事前趋势，反之亦然。我们讨论了两种解决方案。
31063.abstract: We study a difference-in-differences (DiD) framework where groups experience unequal treatment statuses in the pre-policy change period. This approach is commonly employed in empirical studies but it contradicts the canonical model's assumptions. We show that in such settings, the standard DiD approach fails to recover the average treatment effect (ATT), unless the treatment effect is immediate and constant over time. Furthermore, the usual parallel trends test is invalid, meaning one may find pre-trends when the parallel trends assumption holds, and vice versa. We discuss two solutions. First, we show that including a linear term trend will recover the ATT if the differences in trends are constant over time (both in unequal baseline and canonical DiD settings) but not otherwise. Second, estimation in reverse also recovers the ATT if the potential outcomes do not depend on past treatments and post-policy statuses are converging.

31062.title: The Characteristics and Geographic Distribution of Robot Hubs in U.S. Manufacturing Establishments

31062.authors: Erik Brynjolfsson, Cathy Buffington, Nathan Goldschlag, J. Frank Li, Javier Miranda, Robert Seamans
31062.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用制造业年度调查的数据来研究美国制造业企业在机器人投资方面的特征和地理分布。我们发现，机器人采用率和机器人强度（每名员工对应的机器人数量）与企业规模的相关性远强于与企业年龄的相关性。我们发现，报告拥有机器人的企业具有更高的资本支出，包括更高的信息技术（IT）资本支出。此外，如果同一核心统计区（CBSA）和行业内的其他企业也报告拥有机器人，那么企业更有可能拥有机器人。机器人的分布在企业所在地之间高度偏斜。

We find that robotics adoption and robot intensity (the number of robots per employee) is much more strongly related to establishment size than age. We find that establishments that report having robotics have higher capital expenditures, including higher information technology (IT) capital expenditures. Also, establishments are more likely to have robotics if other establishments in the same Core-Based Statistical Area (CBSA) and industry also report having robotics. The distribution of robots is highly skewed across establishments’ locations. Some locations, which we call Robot Hubs, have far more robots than one would expect even after accounting for industry and manufacturing employment. We characterize these Robot Hubs along several industry, demographic, and institutional dimensions. The presence of robot integrators and higher levels of union membership are positively correlated with being a Robot Hub.

31061.abstract: We show that multinational firms transmit shocks across countries through their internal capital markets. We study a credit supply shock to parent firms in Germany. International affiliates outside Germany supported their parents through internal lending, became financially constrained themselves, and experienced lower real growth. We find that managers were "Darwinist" with respect to international affiliates but "Socialist" in the home country, that internal capital markets transmitted the credit shock more strongly than a non-financial shock, and that access to developed credit markets attenuated the real effects. The total real impact of shock transmission through multinationals on foreign economies was large.
